turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I have bad chest pain—upper and lower chest—and it also feels like a heavy, sickening, scary pain. I’m also sweating a lot and I feel really short of breath, and the pain is radiating to both biceps/shoulders and up toward my thyroid cartilage and thoracic spine.

I’m sorry you’re going through that—this sounds potentially serious. **One question at a time:**

**1) When did this chest pain start (exact time or how many hours ago), and is it constant or coming in waves?**
It started very fast—like in minutes. I’d say the onset speed is about 8/10. It’s been going on since it started and it feels pretty constant, not really like it comes and goes.
**2) Does the pain get worse with breathing in, coughing, or moving your chest/arms—or is it the same regardless of movement?**
It feels the same even if I move my arms or chest, and it’s mainly just the heavy sickening pain. I don’t think it’s worse specifically with breathing in or coughing—it's mostly constant.
**3) Do you have any associated symptoms like nausea/vomiting, dizziness/fainting, or a sense of impending doom?**

Yes—I feel really bad and sweaty, and I also have loss of appetite/early satiety. I don’t know about nausea or vomiting, and I don’t feel like I’m going to faint. But the pain feels very scary and intense.
**4) Are you having any trouble speaking, swallowing, drooling, or a change in your voice/hoarseness?**
No, I’m not having trouble speaking or swallowing, and I don’t have drooling or hoarseness.
**5) Do you have any fever, cough, or recent cold/flu-like symptoms?**
No fever, and no cough or recent cold/flu symptoms.
**6) Have you had any leg swelling or pain (especially one-sided), or any recent long travel/surgery/immobility?**
No leg swelling or leg pain that I’ve noticed, and no recent long travel or surgery. I haven’t been immobile recently either.
**7) Do you have any history of heart disease, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, diabetes, or smoking?**

Yes—I'm HIV-positive, I have diabetes, and high cholesterol. I also smoke cigarettes (and I’ve been a former smoker before). I also have had angina/heart attack history—yes, I’ve been told I have that kind of heart issue and poor circulation.
**8) When you say “angina/heart attack history,” have you ever been diagnosed with atrial fibrillation or other rhythm problems?**
I don’t know about atrial fibrillation or rhythm problems—I haven’t been told I have that.
**9) Is the pain associated with exertion or did it happen at rest?**
It happened at rest. I wasn’t doing exercise or anything when it started.
**10) On a scale of 0–10, how severe is the shortness of breath right now, and are you able to lie flat or do you feel worse lying down?**
My shortness of breath is pretty significant right now. I’m not sure about lying flat, but I feel worse with everything since it started.
**11) Do you have any wheezing, history of asthma/COPD, or does it feel like you can’t get air out?**
No wheezing, and I don’t have asthma/COPD history that I know of. It just feels like I can’t breathe well because of the chest pain and pressure—like I can’t get enough air.
**12) Any palpitations (feeling your heart racing or irregular), or did you notice an irregular heartbeat?**
No, I haven’t noticed palpitations or an irregular heartbeat.
**13) Any history of reflux/heartburn, sour taste, or symptoms after meals—or is this completely different from your usual heartburn?**
I do have epigastric pain with this, but it feels different from my usual heartburn. I can’t really say about a sour taste or symptoms after meals right now.
**14) Any recent vomiting/retching or severe upper GI symptoms before this started (which could suggest an esophageal tear)?**
No, I haven’t been vomiting or retching, and no severe upper GI symptoms before it started.
[DDX] Unstable angina, Pulmonary embolism, Acute pulmonary edema, Pneumonia, GERD
